entries.title: Influence Proxy Dashboard
entries.description: Fine-tuning usually hands you a model with no way to ask why. This lets you fine-tune something and then trace its behavior back to the specific training examples that caused it.
entries.detail:
A full-stack research tool for auditable fine-tuning: researchers train a model and see which training examples shaped its behavior.

• Computed influence scores live during training using gradient dot products, requiring no checkpoint storage
• Ran serverless A100 GPU jobs on Modal with async status updates streamed to the frontend in real time
• Visualized per-example influence as animated heatmaps and ranked leaderboards for data auditing
• Designed the full job pipeline from data upload through fine-tuning to score delivery via Supabase Realtime

entries.detail:

entries.title: Cohort Lead @ WAISI

Perception engineer and mentor on Wisconsin Autonomous, competing in the SAE AutoDrive Challenge.

entries.title: Founder & Full-Stack Dev @ Student Success Club

entries.title: Covid-19 Vaccine Stance Classification
entries.description: Can a model tell whether a tweet is pro-vaccine, anti-vaccine, or just being sarcastic? The third one is where everything falls apart.
entries.detail:
A stance classification system labeling tweets as in-favor, against, or neutral-or-unclear toward COVID-19 vaccination, trained under tight data and GPU constraints.

• Fine-tuned FLAN-T5-Large using LoRA adapters on limited hardware
• Designed a curriculum learning strategy to stabilize 3-way stance classification
• Mitigated failure modes including neutral collapse and sarcasm
• Improved macro-F1 and neutral recall over both zero-shot and standard fine-tuning baselines

entries.title: AI Interview Prep Platform
entries.description: Hand it your resume and a job description and it interviews you, then tells you where you were vague. Won first place at a Claude hackathon.
entries.detail:
A full-stack AI interview prep platform that generates personalized questions from a resume and job description, then grades the answers. First place at the Claude hackathon.

• Designed REST APIs for interview sessions, questions, and responses
• Integrated the Claude API for dynamic question generation and answer grading
• Implemented persistent storage for interview history using SQLite
• Built a multi-step frontend flow for interview practice and results review

entries.title: Gesture-Based Game Control
entries.description: You steer Mario Kart by holding your hands up like an actual wheel. Took fourth at a GDG hackathon and was easily the most fun thing I've ever had to demo.
entries.detail:
A real-time gesture controller that lets players drive in Mario Kart with hand movements instead of a physical controller. Fourth place at the Google Developer Groups hackathon.

• Implemented real-time hand tracking and gesture recognition with MediaPipe
• Mapped gestures to in-game controls including steering, acceleration, and item usage
• Supported multiplayer by splitting the camera feed for independent gesture control
• Optimized for low-latency input to keep gameplay smooth and responsive

entries.title: GPU-Accelerated Monte Carlo Option Pricing
entries.description: Pricing options by simulating millions of random market paths, once on a CPU and once on a GPU, mostly to watch how far ahead the GPU pulls as the problem gets bigger.
entries.detail:
A quantitative finance benchmark that prices European options by Monte Carlo simulation on both CPU and GPU, validates the results against the analytical Black-Scholes formula, and measures how GPU speedup scales with problem size.

• Wrote a custom Numba CUDA kernel pricing one option path per GPU thread, generalized with a grid-stride loop so the same kernel scales from 10K to 10M paths
• Cut memory contention with a block-level shared-memory reduction, copying back only two scalars to minimize PCIe transfer
• Generated random numbers on-device with per-thread xoroshiro128+ streams, keeping the entire simulation on the GPU
• Validated against the closed-form Black-Scholes price and benchmarked CPU vs GPU across problem sizes

experience.org: Equistamp · embedded with METR & Redwood Research

❧ Built adversarial attack scenarios for LinuxArena, one of the largest AI control evaluation frameworks to date.
❧ Audited 10 AI research experiments for sabotage and evaluation-integrity failures, delivering code-cited findings for each.
❧ Investigating the representational limits of visualization design guidelines for automated synthesis.
❧ Built and analyzed a corpus of 1.5K+ guidelines across 49 sources to surface inconsistencies between existing frameworks.
❧ Co-authoring a conference paper on a 7-dimension classification schema for comparing guidelines across sources.
❧ Designed and deployed a production ML pipeline for unstructured text classification using LLaMA models, cutting misclassification by ~30%.
❧ Built a scalable LLaMA-based agent framework for multi-step task execution with memory and agent-chaining.

❧ Acted as primary liaison between coaches and engineers, translating product requirements into implementation plans.
❧ Led testing and QA, resolving issues pre-release to improve performance and user experience.
